parts.text: One reason for the stair climber’s popularity is that it’s thought to provide a high-intensity way of boosting

fitness.

But when researchers compared the cardiovascular effects of exercising at the same relative intensity on a treadmill versus a stair climber, they found that those using the stair climbers had lower heart rates and

consumption scores. This meant that stair climbing put less stress on the cardiovascular system, which may ultimately lead to smaller fitness gains.

That said, stair climbing has still been shown to be just as effective as

treadmill walking in lowering blood pressure. A comparison of stair climbing versus treadmill running also showed it improved cardiorespiratory fitness and even promoted similar increases in running performance.

So the stair climber is about

to running when it comes to improving cardiovascular health.

Muscle and strength

Another reason the stair climber is preferred by many gym

is because it’s said to improve muscle health and strength more than other forms of cardio.

Indeed, stair climbing has been shown to engage more lower body muscles than walking or running.

Stair climbing also engages these muscles for longer and with more forceful

than walking. The more a muscle is activated and the longer it is held in one position, the more tension it develops. The greater the tension, the larger the physiological adaptation.

Perhaps

is that stair climbing has been shown to cause changes in muscle size that are similar to those seen in people who did conventional strength training using a leg press. These gains in muscle size were also associated with

in strength.

However, as this study was only conducted in older adults, it’s not clear if these results would also apply to younger people.

The changes in muscle size that are seen in stair climbers are greater than those seen in people who do treadmill walking or

.

An additional benefit of the stair climber may come from using the machine backwards. Walking downstairs activates more muscles than walking upstairs does. This is because our muscles have the additional job of
so we don’t fall or lose balance. This will improve stability while walking.

reading.title: 主旨、理解与信息定位
reading.instruction: 阅读原文后回答 5 道选择题：1 道主旨、1 道内容理解、1 道段落细节、2 道信息定位。段落细节题以题干指定段落为准。

questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the overall focus of this article?
options: Body weight reflects interacting biological, social and environmental influences.
Claims about stair-climbing machines need to be assessed against evidence on fitness and bone health.
The physical properties of foods explain why freezing and thawing affect their textures differently.
The history of the food pyramid shows how nutrition advice and its presentation have changed.
questions.explanation: 把标题与全文各段的中心内容连起来判断主旨，避免把同一主题下的其他话题当成本文重点。
questions.evidence: Proponents of the exercise machine rave about its benefits – claiming it can boost cardiovascular fitness, strength and bone health.

questions.prompt: What was observed when stair climbers and treadmills were compared at the same relative intensity?
options: Both machines made heart rate impossible to measure.
Treadmill users did not consume any oxygen.
The results proved that exercise never benefits cardiovascular health.
Stair-climber users had lower heart rates and oxygen consumption scores.
questions.explanation: 第 5 段提供了作答依据。正确选项用不同说法表达了文中的信息；请比较范围、数量、因果关系与限定词。
questions.evidence: But when researchers compared the cardiovascular effects of exercising at the same relative intensity on a treadmill versus a stair climber, they found that those using the stair climbers had lower heart rates and oxygen consumption scores.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is explicitly made in paragraph 12?
options: Evidence shows the stair climber does have many benefits when it comes to health and fitness.
Though long-term weight loss success will ultimately depend on maintaining a consistent exercise routine.
The stair climber has seen a huge surge in popularity on social media in recent years.
Perhaps unsurprisingly is that stair climbing has been shown to cause changes in muscle size that are similar to those seen in people who did conventional strength training using a leg press.
questions.explanation: 定位第 12 段，比较四个选项的具体信息。其余选项来自本文其他段落，并非本段明确陈述的内容。
questions.evidence: Perhaps unsurprisingly is that stair climbing has been shown to cause changes in muscle size that are similar to those seen in people who did conventional strength training using a leg press.
